云氏大殿前，万修俯首。
高台之上，两道身影并肩而立。一人玄衣墨发，重瞳寂灭万法；一人金袍猎猎，煌阳威断八荒。
下方，有小童稚声问道：“爷爷，台上站在仙帝身边的那个人是谁呀？他为什么不用跪下？”
白发苍苍的老祖连忙捂住孩子的嘴，眼中尽是崇敬与追忆，他压低声音，颤巍巍道：
“有一种人，生而为臣，却终与君共揽云巅……”
“那是——君之半身，帝之逆鳞。”
时光流转，他仿佛又看到了许多年前，那个孤身入局，面对仙帝转世的弟弟，不得不谨小慎微的庶长公子，真是物是人非啊。（上述非大结局）
……
三千大世界，天元大陆，东域，上古世家云氏族地。
今日是云氏十年一度的测灵仪典。既是检验年轻一辈天资禀赋的典礼，也是旁系和庶出子弟鱼跃龙门，争取家族资源倾斜的重要机会。
本是清雅的日子，气氛却莫名有些肃杀。
巨大的场地内落针可闻，悬浮的数十面灵镜将场内每一缕气息都映照得无所遁形。所有视线，或明或暗，都时不时地瞟向高台。
高台之上，一位少年独坐主位之上，正是云氏年仅十六的少家主——云煌！
你问当代家主？他连出席的资格都没有，云氏内外早已明晰，所有权柄尽归少君之手。
即便静坐不言，那源于“元煌神体”的煌煌威压，也如一轮无形大日，令周遭空间微微震颤，无人敢直视锋芒。
云煌淡金色的眼瞳扫视台下，带着与生俱来的威仪与疏离。
不止是他，在场所有人都在等待着那个名字。
云氏庶长子，云擎。
今日，正是他回族的日子。

云擎这个名字，在云氏年轻一代中，充满了神秘与争议。据说他甫一出生便被测出惊世天赋，随即被二长老带入秘境“混沌古洞”中苦修，十余年来从未露面。
然而家族资源常年向其倾斜，甚至早早就被内定为这一代“十二公子”之首，普通长老都得尊称其一声“大公子”。
凭什么？
一个庶子，凭什么能凌驾于所有嫡系子弟之上，就凭那被长老们讳莫如深的“天赋”？云氏位列四古世家之首，族中多少天骄俊杰？
“哼，装神弄鬼十几年，今日是骡子是马，拉出来遛遛。”一名身具“炎陵真传”的嫡系公子低声嗤笑。
“能占据‘大公子’之位，想必不是徒有虚名之辈。但少君最厌恶庶出跋扈，今日，有好戏看了。”
没错，这位掌控家族至高权柄的少君有一个大病：
“厌庶癖。”
严重到甚至立下族规：“庶子面君，需跪地应答。”
违者，下场凄惨。
有位自恃天赋的庶子云厉，因在家族任务汇报时，仅是躬身而未跪，便被云煌一道煌阳神力直接压跪在地。丹田受创不说，更成了族中笑柄。
“云擎，你终于要露面了！”人群后方，云厉下意识摸了摸仍隐隐作痛的丹田，眼神中充满恐惧与…期待。
嫉妒、好奇、质疑，种种私语在人群中流淌。
高台上，大长老云彻面容古井无波，其他几位长老嘴角都噙着笑意，一派老神在在。他们互相对视一眼，等待好戏开幕。
“家族里这些小家伙们，也该知晓什么叫人外有人，天外有天喽。”
长老们自然知晓这位大公子的底细。

In front of Yun's main hall, Wan Xiu bowed his head.
On the high platform, two figures stood side by side. One person is wearing mysterious clothes and has black hair, his heavy eyes destroy all dharmas; the other person is hunting in golden robes, and his brilliant sun cuts through all the wasteland.
Below, a childish voice asked: "Grandpa, who is that person standing next to the Immortal Emperor on the stage? Why doesn't he kneel down?"
The white-haired ancestor quickly covered the child's mouth, his eyes full of reverence and remembrance. He lowered his voice and said tremblingly:
"There is a kind of person who is born to be a minister, but eventually reaches the top of the clouds with the king..."
"That is - the half body of the king, the reverse scale of the emperor."
As time went by, he seemed to see the eldest son who entered the situation alone many years ago and had to be cautious when facing the reincarnated brother of the Immortal Emperor. He was really different. (The above is not the finale)
…
Three Thousand Great Worlds, Tianyuan Continent, Eastern Region, the land of the ancient aristocratic Yun clan.
Today is Yun's ten-year spiritual testing ceremony. It is not only a ceremony to test the talents of the younger generation, but also an important opportunity for the descendants of collateral and concubine families to compete for family resources.
It was an elegant day, but the atmosphere was inexplicably a bit solemn.
You can hear a needle drop in the huge venue, and dozens of suspended spiritual mirrors reflect every breath in the venue. All eyes, bright or dark, glance towards the high platform from time to time.
On the high platform, a young man sat alone on the throne. It was the sixteen-year-old young head of the Yun family—Yun Huang!
You ask the contemporary family head? He was not even qualified to attend. It was already clear both inside and outside the Yun family that all authority was in the hands of Shaojun.
Even if he sat quietly and said nothing, the brilliant pressure originating from the "Yuanhuang Divine Body" was like an invisible sun, causing the surrounding space to tremble slightly, and no one dared to look directly at the sharp edge.
Yunhuang's pale golden eyes scanned the audience, carrying an innate sense of dignity and alienation.
Not just him, everyone present was waiting for that name.
The eldest son of Yun's concubine, Yun Qing.
Today is the day when he returns to his clan.
The name Yun Qing is full of mystery and controversy among the younger generation of the Yun family. It is said that he was found to have an astonishing talent right after he was born, and was immediately taken into the secret realm "Ancient Chaos Cave" by the second elder to practice hard. He has not been seen for more than ten years.
However, family resources have always been tilted towards him, and he was even designated as the first of the "Twelve Young Masters" of this generation early on. Ordinary elders have to respectfully call him "Eldest Young Master".
Why?
How could a concubine be superior to all his direct descendants just because of his "talent" that was kept secret by the elders? The Yun family ranks first among the four ancient aristocratic families. How many talented people are there in the family?
"Hmph, you have been pretending to be a god for more than ten years. Today, you are either a mule or a horse. Let's take him out for a walk." A direct son with the "True Inheritance of Yanling" sneered in a low voice.
"To be able to occupy the position of 'Eldest Young Master', he must be worthy of his reputation. But the young master hates common people being domineering the most. Today, we have a good show."
That's right, this young gentleman who controls the supreme authority of the family has a serious illness:
"Disgusting with concubines."
It was so serious that they even established a clan rule: "A bastard must kneel down when he meets a king."
Violators will face a miserable fate.
Yun Li, a concubine who relied on his talent, was directly pressed to the ground by Yun Huang's radiant sun power because he only bowed but did not kneel when reporting on the family mission. Not only was his Dantian injured, he became the laughingstock of the clan.
"Yun Qing, you are finally showing up!" Behind the crowd, Yun Li subconsciously touched his Dantian that was still aching, his eyes full of fear and...expectation.
Jealousy, curiosity, doubt, all kinds of whispers flowed among the crowd.
On the high platform, the great elder Yun Che's face remained calm, and the other elders all had smiles on their lips, looking like an old god. They looked at each other and waitedThe show begins.
"These little guys in the family should also know what it means to be someone outside the world, and there is a world outside the world."
The elders naturally knew the details of this eldest young master.
